title: EKODI International Platform Maturity Model
purpose: Measure implementation maturity against internationally recognized management, security, privacy, resilience, AI and software quality standards without implying certification.
disclaimer: Scores are EKODI internal evidence-based maturity scores. They are not ISO/IEC certification results and must never be presented as certification.

scale.name: Initial
scale.definition: Ad hoc practice exists but ownership and evidence are incomplete.

scale.name: Managed
scale.definition: Documented practice and responsible owner exist; execution is partially repeatable.

scale.name: Defined
scale.definition: Platform-wide standard process, evidence and verification are established.

scale.name: Measured
scale.definition: Controls are continuously measured with thresholds, audit evidence and corrective action.

scale.name: Optimizing
scale.definition: Closed-loop improvement is evidence-driven, predictive where justified, independently reviewable and continuously improved.

governance.assessmentRule: Every score must cite repository evidence, a measurable control, or an explicit gap. Unsupported score increases are forbidden.
governance.changeRule: Assessment changes are pull-request reviewed and append an immutable history snapshot.
governance.certificationRule: Only an accredited external certification may be described as certified.
governance.targetRule: Level 5 is a continual-improvement target, not a one-time completion badge.
